stem: Which sentence should come before sentence 11 to serve as an introductory sentence for the third paragraph (sentences 11–13)?

options.label: A
options.text: Thomas’s father looked at the dark clouds forming in the sky.

options.label: B
options.text: Thomas’s father knew almost all of the craftsmen in town.

options.label: C
options.text: Thomas’s father had nine other children back at the family farm.

options.label: D
options.text: Thomas’s father continued to offer encouraging words.
